non-overlapping.evidence: Re-run tools:invoke {"name":"rubrics:get","args":{"rubricRef":"acceptance-cloud-cross-feature-e2e-shipment-2026-10-08","revision":6,"detail":"full","payloadTier":"full"}} and distinguish outcomes by these fifteen pairwise design witnesses (the latter key fails while the earlier key can meet its own scoped evidence): R1/R2 inventoried journey has no persistent detector; R1/R3 inventory complete but negative control uncaught; R1/R4 inventory complete but repair proposed; R1/R5 inventory complete but real provider missing; R1/R6 inventory complete but shipped digest wrong; R2/R3 happy detector passes but permission control uncaught; R2/R4 happy detector passes but discovered repair unverified; R2/R5 passing fixture detector lacks actual provider; R2/R6 candidate detector passes but deployment ref false; R3/R4 adversarial detector passes but originating repair lacks triggering proof; R3/R5 fixture recovery passes but real AWS missing; R3/R6 candidate adversarial proof passes but post-deploy report mismatched; R4/R5 committed repair+rerun passes but real runtime missing; R4/R6 committed repair+rerun passes but deployed artifact differs; R5/R6 eligible real candidate execution passes but promoted/deployed identity differs. These are criterion-discriminating scenarios derived from immutable models/methods, not claims that hypothetical inputs are actual runtime evidence. R6's requirement that earlier bars pass is a final shipment dependency, while its own artifact/order/report failure is independently observable.

'cloud campaign measured evidence contradictions > rejects invented nonempty shipment promotionRef' AS saved_promotion_detector, execution_details->'passedCaseTitles' ? 'cloud campaign measured evidence contradictions > independently rejects an uncaught adversarial control' AS saved_adversarial_detector, execution_details->'passedCaseTitles' ? 'cloud campaign measured evidence contradictions > keeps the actual campaign incomplete even if its authored status claims shipped' AS saved_actual_nonpass_detector FROM harness_shared.test_runs WHERE workspace_id = 'papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug = 'papercusp' AND file_path = 'packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/cloud-e2e-campaign-evidence.test.ts' AND id IN (20963516,20963532) ORDER BY id LIMIT 2","allowUnscoped":false,"maxRows":2,"timeoutMs":5000}. Observed two complete rows, schema_version1: 20963516 fail, passed0/failed6/skipped50, collection_failedfalse, selector 'rejects invented nonempty shipment', with the six promotion/deployment/audit/grading/reportReadback/servingIdentity assertion titles; 20963532 pass, passed92/failed0/skipped0, collection_failedfalse, selector null, saved_passed_titles64, saved promotion/adversarial/actual-nonpass detectors true. Direct testing:runs {testRunIds:[20963516,20963532],payloadTier:'full'} currently omits executionDetails. No unavailable capability:git-evidence call or newer working tree substitutes for historical source. Thus current complete binding adequacy remains unverified and this criterion is weak, not pass. Unit checker observations do not satisfy actual R2-R6 outcomes.

falsifiable-with-evidence.evidence: Re-run tools:invoke {"name":"rubrics:get","args":{"rubricRef":"acceptance-cloud-cross-feature-e2e-shipment-2026-10-08","revision":6,"detail":"full","payloadTier":"full"}} and read each of the six driftMarkers plus replication fields, rather than a reviewer's conclusion. Specific fail observations are: R1 omitted/duplicate supported population member; R2 missing persistent happy detector or absent measured affected selection; R3 accepted unauthorized operation, lost recovery state, leaked secret or uncaught/missing boundary control; R4 proposed/open originating repair or missing recurrence/triggering proof; R5 synthetic/unauthenticated/wrong-source/account/label/stale or missing provider/census/billing records; R6 wrong/nonexistent canonical promotion/deploy/serving/audit/grade/report ref, wrong shipped digest, pre-deploy final execution or unresolved earlier bar. Each replication names maintained checker execution followed by independently collected actual context and explicit contradictions that must stay nonpass. This is direct immutable design evidence; no historical count or unavailable Git-byte replay supports this pass.
